title: SILICON VALLEY
subtitle: skipto.tv
blurb: Six seasons of Pied Piper: a compression algorithm that wins TechCrunch Disrupt, survives a Hooli lawsuit, a CEO merry-go-round and a decentralized-internet pivot, and ends up nearly breaking encryption for the entire planet. Every founder, funder, and Hooli exec who came and went, charted season by season.
regularsNote: Series regulars — Richard, Erlich (through S4), Dinesh, Gilfoyle, Jared, Big Head, Monica and Gavin — aren't listed here; use the roster and Hooli rows on the chart for them. Jian-Yang, Russ Hanneman and Jack Barker were promoted from recurring to regular partway through the show, so their early episodes still turn up in this guest-character dropdown alongside Laurie Bream, Peter Gregory and about 350 more.
chartHint: Six seasons across. Click any bar to filter the episode list; mid-season handoffs (CEOs especially) are drawn at season granularity with the exact episode noted in the label.
